payload.intro: Take on my assignments out past the ditch, and the beasts might leave you something special.
payload.prompt: Which key opens the pirate chests hidden deep in the Wilderness?

payload.intro: Braving the Wilderness carries real risks, so I always make sure the payoff is worth your time.
payload.prompt: How many Slayer points does Krystilia give as a base reward for a task?

payload.intro: Be careful out there in the Wilderness! A Teleblock can really ruin an escape!
payload.prompt: Without Protect from Magic, how many minutes does a full Teleblock last?

payload.intro: Be careful pulling strange levers! The one behind the Ardougne tavern sends an unwary traveller straight to the Deserted Keep.
payload.prompt: At what Wilderness level does the Ardougne lever drop you?

payload.intro: Mandro runs a handy resource haven out past the lava, though he asks for a little toll at the gate.
payload.prompt: Without diary perks, how many coins does it cost to enter the Resource Area?

payload.intro: Ancient Magicks can be a real lifesaver when you need to make a getaway.
payload.prompt: Which spell freezes a pursuer in place for 20 seconds?

payload.intro: Some of my assignments end at a boss's lair, deep past the ditch. Know where you're going before you go.
payload.prompt: Which of these bosses lurk in the Wilderness?

payload.intro: The last time I contacted Nieve with Astral Contact, she couldn't stop talking about her ridiculous number of relatives.
payload.prompt: Who from Nieve's family guards the Morytania Spider Cave?
payload.explanation: Each of these family members guards a different Slayer-only area. Weave's name is very fitting for her area.

payload.intro: Don't go charging into a Slayer tower without the levels to back it up. Rank these monsters by the Slayer level needed to harm them!
payload.prompt: Order these Slayer monsters by their required Slayer level, from lowest to highest.
payload.explanation: Crawling Hands require level 5 Slayer, Bloodvelds 50, Dust devils 65, Gargoyles 75, Nechryael 80 and Abyssal demons 85.

payload.intro: Both the multi-combat Wilderness bosses and their single-way cousins drop signature rings. Do you know which beasts drop which?
payload.prompt: Sort these six Wilderness bosses by the unique ring they drop.
payload.explanation: The bears Callisto and Artio drop the Tyrannical ring, the spiders Venenatis and Spindel drop the Treasonous ring, and the skeletons Vet'ion and Calvar'ion drop the Ring of the gods.

payload.intro: Past level 20 Wilderness most of your precious teleports stop working—and past 30, only the obelisks and levers can save you!
payload.prompt: Sort these teleport methods by the deepest Wilderness level from which they can be used.
payload.explanation: Standard teleports and most jewellery stop working past level 20 Wilderness, dragonstone jewellery and the royal seed pod work up to level 30, and Wilderness Obelisks and levers work at any depth unless you are Teleblocked.

payload.intro: The ghosts in the Revenant Caves carry ancient weapons that drink ether and shred anything in the Wilderness.
payload.prompt: Which three weapons are upgraded from Viggora's chainmace, Craw's bow and Thammaron's sceptre?
payload.explanation: Using boss drops from Callisto, Venenatis and Vet'ion upgrades the three Revenant weapons into the Ursine chainmace, Webweaver bow and Accursed sceptre.

payload.intro: Every Slayer worth their salt wears an imbued Slayer helmet. How much extra punch does it give your blade on task?
payload.prompt: Rounded to the nearest whole percent, by what percentage does a Slayer helmet boost your Melee accuracy and damage on a Slayer task?
payload.explanation: A black mask or Slayer helmet boosts Melee accuracy and strength by 7/6 (16.67%), while an imbued helmet also boosts Ranged and Magic by 15%.
